::: {#exr-elephant-show-hamper}
Consider a function defined as follows:

```r
heat_index <- function(temperature, humidity) {
  # algorithm
}
```

Which function invocation correctly supplies the arguments by name rather than by position?

```{mcq}
#| label: d06-interface-01
1. `heat_index(30, 0.80)`
2. `heat_index(temperature = 30, humidity = 0.80)` [correct]
3. `heat_index(30 = temperature, 0.80 = humidity)`
4. `heat_index(temperature, humidity)`
```

:::
 <!-- end of exr-elephant-show-hamper -->
